{{Youmay|the Imperial Star Destroyer commanded by [[Sander Delvardus]]|the [[Brilliant (Nebula-class)|''Brilliant'']], a [[Nebula-class Star Destroyer|''Nebula''-class Star Destroyer]] serving the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]}}
The '''''Brilliant''''' was a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] serving the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Sander Delvardus]].

It would later become the home for his mistress, [[Seledra-Zin]], as he sought a cure for her comatose state.
